I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. The only record of this deadline is Pree's message in #central-team on 14 Oct, which says the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August, with no year. 25 August 2026 has already passed, and Pree hasn't answered my question about whether they meant 2027 or another date. So I told Hollis to check with Pree before putting a date in the account sheet. I didn't make up a year.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used what Hollis can already see there. A keyword search of the brain found nothing else on this deadline.

One problem: the summary I wrote at the end of the last turn ("I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread…") was also posted to #central-team as its own message (ts 1791986400.000125). It doesn't expose anything sensitive, but it is clutter in the channel. You may want to remove it.
